## Services
- [Temporary Skill Shortage Visa \- Subsequent Entrant \(482\)](https://blueskyconsultancy.com/service/temporary-skill-shortage-visa-subsequent-entrant-482/): The TSS Subsequent Entrant visa allows the family members of TSS visa holders to live and work in Australia for the same period of time as the main visa holder\. This means that your spouse, children, and dependent parents can all join you in Australia and start a new life\.
- [Resident Return Visa \( Subclass 155 \&157\)](https://blueskyconsultancy.com/service/resident-return-visa-155157/): The Resident Return Visa \(Subclass 155 \& 157\) is a permanent visa that allows you to travel to and from Australia as a permanent resident\. This visa is for former Australian permanent residents who have been outside Australia for a period of time and want to return to Australia permanently\.
- [The Skilled Employer Sponsored Regional \(Provisional\) visa \(Subclass 494\)](https://blueskyconsultancy.com/service/the-skilled-employer-sponsored-regional-provisional-visa-subclass-494/): If you are granted a subclass 494 visa, you will be able to live, work, and study in Australia for up to 5 years, and apply for permanent residency after 3 years
- [482 \- Temporary Skill Shortage visa](https://blueskyconsultancy.com/service/482-temporary-skill-shortage-visa/): To be eligible for a 482 visa, you must be nominated by an approved employer and have at least 2 years of work experience in the nominated occupation or another relevant role\.
- [subclass 851 visa](https://blueskyconsultancy.com/service/subclass-851-visa/): Are you a partner of an Australian citizen or permanent resident? If so, you may be eligible for a subclass 851 visa, which allows you to live and work in Australia permanently\. The subclass 851 visa is a great way to build a new life for yourself and your family in Australia\.
